claims.quote: Loss of myosin Va function also blocked distal localization of vesicle-associated membrane protein 2 (VAMP2)
When VAMP2 function was disrupted, oligodendrocytes exhibited similar morphologic deficits to what is seen with functional ablation of myosin Va.

claims.object_text: oligodendrocyte function as it relates to myelination
claims.quote: Our findings establish a role for both myosin Va and VAMP2 in oligodendrocyte function as it relates to myelination.
